content.comment_body: How can I make the workspace in [product_name] larger? I have a project file that extends from the top to the bottom of the current workspace, and I need to add more symbols to the bottom area. What is the method to expand the workspace or layer?
Have you tried pressing Alt+Enter to access the properties? In the 'Page' tab, you should be able to adjust the workspace size. Hopefully this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is facing difficulty with the limited workspace size in [product_name], which restricts the ability to add more symbols or elements to their project. This suggests that users may find the default working area insufficient for larger or more complex diagrams, potentially affecting workflow efficiency and scalability.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to seamlessly expand the working area in [product_name] to organize their project better and include additional elements as needed.
